what: 望 (wàng): what is trending in Chinese media right now, translated. A feed to explore. Nothing here is scored or read by Prism.
source: Each platform's own public hot list, read directly by chinavision-pull.py. Not read this time: Zhihu: HTTPError HTTP Error 403: Forbidden.
notesBy: Accounts, quotes and reception are written by local:qwen, on this Mac from the news pages it read. Reception comes from three places, each named beside it: the article itself, the hourly roundup published on Sina, and the top comments under the most-watched videos on Bilibili. What is visible is what was allowed to stay up. Accounts are in its own words; a quote is kept only when it is found exactly in its source and is short. The full texts stay on this Mac (data/chinavision/raw/) and are not shown.

items.zh: 小雪节气来临 两类人要格外当心
items.en: Minor Snow solar term arrives; two groups of people should be especially careful
items.note: The article marks the arrival of the 'Minor Snow' solar term, the 20th in the traditional Chinese calendar, signaling the onset of colder weather and the first snows. It explains that while temperatures drop, the ground is not yet deeply frozen, which defines the 'minor' nature of the snowfall. The text outlines traditional customs, such as eating hot pot in the north and rice cakes in the south, alongside health advice to prevent 'heating sickness' from indoor heating. It recommends specific dietary and lifestyle adjustments to maintain well-being during this transitional period.

sources.name: IT Home
sources.title: 今日小雪：雨凝为雪，地气冻结
sources.titleEn: Today is Minor Snow: Rain condenses into snow, and the earth's energy freezes

items.more: This solar term occurs on November 22 or 23 when the sun reaches a celestial longitude of 240 degrees. The article notes that northern regions will experience their first snow, while southern areas observe specific food traditions like consuming glutinous rice cakes. Health experts advise eating warming foods like walnuts and ginger while avoiding excessive sugar, salt, and lard. The piece also highlights the importance of outdoor activities to combat seasonal mood changes associated with the darker weather.

items.zh: 乌解释打击克里米亚大桥行动缘由
items.en: Ukraine explains reasons for striking the Crimean Bridge [key transport link between Russia and annexed Crimea]
items.note: Ukrainian forces attacked the Crimean Bridge, prompting Russian President Vladimir Putin to declare that negotiations regarding a maritime ceasefire or energy facility protections are no longer possible. Putin stated that Russia will respond to the strikes with greater force than Ukraine used in the attack. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed that his security services and military used drones and missiles to damage the bridge's road and rail infrastructure. The report notes that Russia claims the bridge was used only for civilian purposes, not for transporting military equipment or oil.

sources.name: China News Service
sources.title: 克里米亚大桥遭袭 普京发声

items.more: The attacks occurred on November 16, 17, and 18, causing disruptions to traffic on the 19-kilometer structure that connects the Crimean Peninsula to Russia's Krasnodar region. Zelenskyy confirmed the strikes on the morning of November 17, specifying the use of multiple drones and Neptune missiles. Putin attended the opening ceremonies for both the road bridge in 2018 and the railway bridge in 2019. The article does not provide specific details on the extent of the damage or the number of casualties.

items.zh: 美国人为什么开始反对AI了
items.en: Why are Americans starting to oppose AI?
items.note: Three U.S. senators have criticized Apple, Google, and Meta for failing to remove AI applications that generate non-consensual nude images from their platforms. The lawmakers argue that despite existing policies banning such content, these apps remain available or are promoted through advertising, causing significant harm to women and children. The companies responded by stating they actively detect and remove harmful content, though the senators contend these measures are insufficient.

sources.name: IT Home
sources.title: 美参议员痛批苹果、谷歌：放任 AI 脱衣应用“野蛮生长”
sources.titleEn: US Senator criticizes Apple and Google for allowing AI nude photo apps to flourish unchecked

items.more: The senators sent a letter to the CEOs of the three tech giants on the 18th, warning that Congress may intervene if the companies do not strengthen their enforcement. A UNICEF report cited in the article indicates that at least 1.2 million children in 11 countries reported experiencing non-consensual nude image abuse. The senators specifically named Ron Wyden, Ed Markey, and Ben Cardin as the officials leading this inquiry.
